items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: He says, 'Well, Topsy, I know you used to play horn,' that's what he called me sometimes

ctx.x: change speed. And it would build.

Now, when I first came from Milwaukee here, all the trumpet players -- all the trumpet players knocked me. They knocked me so til one day Preston Jackson came over to my house. He says, "Well, Topsy, I know you used to play horn," that's what he called me sometimes --
